# V4 Production Readiness and Foundation Recovery Contract

Issued 9 November 2026. This is an integral, controlling supplement to the full V3 master above. The product requirements and all approved Signature Flow UIX decisions remain binding. P1, P2 and P3 are proposed isolated changes, not authorisation to modify production.

# 1 Decision and scope

KK authorises preparation, isolated implementation, testing and documented review of the six foundation gaps. No read-only production query, production migration, protected merge, release, public-domain or branding change, external message, tax filing or financial posting is authorised merely by this document. Each requires its own approval when consequential.

Order of effort: access control and recovery safeguards → entity/data isolation → one balanced accounting engine → historical integrity → first bank-month end-to-end journey → complete screen coverage and UIX parity. Dependencies can be investigated in parallel but production changes remain serial and reversible.

# 2 Evidence baseline and reliability

The 9 November initial registers cover 68 architecture features and 1,536 unique REQ IDs. Architecture status: 21 implemented, 32 partial, 14 missing, one blocked. Requirements: 485 not started, 786 in progress, 42 built without tests, 185 locally tested, 38 blocked. These are reported, provisional historical snapshots, not current live-readiness counts. The later Claude report corrected 169 heading rows and twelve overstated claims; do not silently reconcile these counts without the latest register revision.

Claude later reported 111 functional screen rows: eight fully built, 96 partial, six missing and one provider-blocked. Three High security findings remained open. The isolated P1/P2/P3 plans reportedly passed 2,317 tests, but no hosted migration or live functional verification was performed. Gate 1 therefore remains OPEN.

# 3 Six foundation gaps and completion conditions

## FND-01 Balanced double-entry accounting

• Inventory all existing financial write paths, events, expenses, journals, derived reports and accounting API calls; record exact code and database objects.

• Design one authoritative posting service and journal schema on the existing financial system: posting batch, source event, posting lines, entity, currency, period, reversal and idempotency identity.

• Database must reject unbalanced entries; verify sum of debits equals sum of credits within each legally relevant posting group, using precise decimal arithmetic and explicit currency handling.

• Prevent duplicate economic effects across receipt, bank row, card row, upload retries and reimbursements. Linked views must not create independent books.

• Posted entries immutable; corrections by audited reversal and successor entries; periods lock and reopen only through approved role and reason.

• Historical conversion is previewed and owner-approved, never automatic. Unmatched historical items remain exceptions; do not fabricate balancing transactions.

• Personal finance requires coherent accounting semantics, even if it uses a different reporting basis from company statutory books.

• Acceptance: seeded trial balance balances, adversarial unbalanced entry rejected at database, idempotent repeated upload, period lock and reversal tests, GL/subledger/report parity.

## FND-02 Legal entity separation

• Represent individual, company, trust, HUF, LLP and supported organisation as distinct legal entities, separate from UI workspace labels.

• Separate legal owner, user, payer, beneficiary, asset custodian and group reporting membership. Joint and intercompany ownership relationships must be explicit.

• Every financial row and original document carries enforceable entity ownership. Cross-entity views are permission-scoped and cannot be acquired by URL or client-side manipulation.

• Current Me, Family and Business labels must be mapped without assigning legacy personal records to companies by guesswork.

• Adult family privacy and consent are preserved; professional access is scoped to approved companies, purpose and time.

• Acceptance: negative cross-tenant tests for read, write, import, export and attachment URLs; company books reconcile independently; controlled group consolidation eliminates eligible internal balances.

## FND-03 Database relationships

• Inventory JSON/blob-based preferences and registers used for companies, trips, assets, properties, leases, invoices and tax records. Preserve existing source data.

• Design normalized records with stable IDs, unique constraints, foreign keys, ownership policies and source-document links; retain legacy IDs and provenance.

• Asset, property, loan, investment and trip detail must link to the correct accounting account and economic event, not hold independent editable financial totals.

• A property can contain multiple assets for location/maintenance. Market valuation and carrying-value consolidation must not double count property components.

• Bulk asset imports (5,000 or more), legacy PDF/Excel registers and prior financial history need deterministic match/upsert, exceptions and reconciliation preview.

• Migration stages: schema additive → dual-read compatibility → validated backfill → compare reports → gated read switch → write-path switch → cleanup only after separate approval.

• Acceptance: referential integrity, zero orphan rows after backfill, exact source counts and hashes, no changed historical balances, repeatable rollback or restore.

## FND-04 Access control and privacy

• P1 security containment must restrict finance/manager to explicitly granted company scopes; departments grant no access; personal records stay private.

• P2 new roles and invitation audit may be installed separately; no existing can-edit grant automatically gains Bookkeeper posting or Company Secretary powers.

• Prevent reassignment of record/document ownership, unauthorised folder uploads and insecure document linking. Preserve normal owner restore and correction.

• Resolve external assistant token revocation and privilege limits; implement agreed five-minute phone and fifteen-minute desktop idle policy and step-up for approval/export.

• Correct Team Access UI wording before P1 activation. Test passkeys against current allowed domains and eventual Thapal domain.

• Remove type checking suppression in critical SQL acceptance test. Backups, consent, exports, audit, incident review and deletions need verified policies.

• Acceptance: server/db role matrix; attempted privilege escalation, cross-account restore, stale session, revoked invitation and export leakage all rejected.

## FND-05 Historical financial integrity

• Freeze read-only baseline: row counts, balances by entity/account/currency/period, document hashes, source references and journal/report snapshots.

• Do not change transactions from April 2026 onward without approved correction. Distinguish observation, candidate match, posting and reconciliation.

• Maintain legacy import identity and source row/page reference; reprocessing must preserve extraction versions and never repost already-represented events.

• Protect source-preserving delete, restore, reverse, reopen, prior-period adjustment and audit history. Existing team-expense records cannot be deleted during role migration.

• Run migration on production-like restored copy with P1/P2/P3 and proposed older staged SQL; verify rollback and data parity, including multi-entity and foreign currencies.

• Acceptance: every historical discrepancy is documented; exact opening and closing balance bridge; zero unauthorized alterations; successful independently checked restore.

## FND-06 Full UIX page implementation

• The approved visual authority remains Signature Flow Concept 06, rated 10/10. Wordmark must read Thapal; Option 02 minimalist T awaits final approved SVG. No invented replacement.

• Map all 111 A01--K12 screens to routes, states, roles, data source, relevant REQ IDs, reports, deep links and acceptance tests. Use actual latest screen register.

• Current navigation must transition from eight destinations plus Spaces to Home, Money, To-do and Records with one central Add, preserving access to existing functions.

• Missing known pages: calendar event, bank account detail, projects, trip collaborators, Malaysia/other countries and version information. Holdings, assets and properties also require proper detail pages.

• For every screen verify loading, empty, error, offline/queued, blocked, approval, corrected and success states; back navigation preserves task context.

• Smart Add must show document preview then extracted suggestions and source/account link before confirmation; no accidental keyboard launch or unexpected Statement Desk redirect.

• Real iPhone, iPad portrait/landscape and desktop screenshots must be compared to the approved captures; keyboard, screen reader, zoom and reduced motion tested.

• Acceptance: 111/111 rows evidence-complete; no dead actions or misleading downloads; cross-module deep links and report flows pass.

# 4 Migration packages and separation of authority

  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Package                 Purpose                                                                                                           Approval gate
  ----------------------- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  P1                      Contain High security issues and preserve owner paths, role boundaries and deletion coverage.                     Review exact SQL and changed code; isolated restore; production-like snapshot; explicit production approval.

  P2                      Add V3.1 roles, scoped invitation, expiry, revocation and audit without altering existing effective rights yet.   Separate identity/role migration and activation approvals.

  P3                      Enforce balanced immutable journal, source idempotency and period lock using existing records.                    Review fourteen Section 10 accounting decisions; migration + UI activation separately approved.
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

No automatic application of the eight previously staged SQL changes. Compare them one by one with P1--P3 dependencies, existing schema and rollback design. Production PostgreSQL version and compatibility must be verified; P3 reportedly requires PostgreSQL 15 or newer.

# 5 Required financial integrity invariants

• Each posted entry is balanced at the database, not only in the application.

• Economic event unique key prevents replay after worker restart, upload retry or multi-document match.

• A card purchase creates expense/asset plus liability; card bill payment only settles liability.

• A personal company expense creates company expense and reimbursement payable/receivable; reimbursement settlement does not duplicate it.

• Loans split principal, interest and charges; deposit movement is not income; property security deposits are liabilities when appropriate.

• Source-document hashes, parsed row IDs and posting links are stable; reimports do not mutate posted history.

• Every report identifies entity, currency, period, preparation/reconciliation status and evidence; cross-format totals must agree.

• Group summaries eliminate internal balances correctly and never treat a transfer as revenue.

# 6 First complete acceptance journey

1\. Create a properly isolated company with approved opening financial schedule and bank account.

2\. Upload an independently authored complete statement through Smart Add / Statement Desk; preserve PDF and page/row references.

3\. Extract rows into observations, identify account/entity, match invoices and receipts, prevent reuse of duplicate documents.

4\. Review uncertain amounts, dates, tax or owner classification; represent unmatched rows as exceptions rather than inventing entries.

5\. Post through P3 controlled journal only after applicable confirmation threshold and owner policy.

6\. Reconcile opening-to-closing bank balance and all journal/subledger balances; demonstrate partial payment, bank fee, card payment and refund cases.

7\. Generate GL, trial balance, P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, bank reconciliation and detailed expense report in PDF, XLSX and CSV, with matching totals.

8\. Confirm locked month and reversal workflow; test accountant scoped access, inaccessible personal records, export permission and audit evidence.

9\. Interrupt upload and restore from backup; retry idempotently; verify no duplicate effects and proper device notifications.

10\. Run on realistic data and iPhone/iPad/desktop, record screenshots and timing. No production signoff until all steps pass.

# 7 Gate sequence and decision matrix

  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Gate                     Evidence required                                                                                               Exit condition
  ------------------------ --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  G1 Architecture          Code-to-spec map, 68 architecture features, actual database ERD, write paths, 111 screen register, decisions.   Every mandatory register field evidenced; no invented completeness.

  G2 Security              P1/P2 negative-access tests, backup restore, token revocation, session/step-up, role migration.                 High security findings closed in production-like test.

  G3 Accounting            P3 final design, 14 decisions signed, controlled balanced posting, old-data parity and rollback.                Financial invariants demonstrably enforced.

  G4 First bank month      Complete end-to-end statement-to-closed-books case with independent source calculations.                        No unexplained variance or duplicate effect.

  G5 Modules               Accounts-linked travel, expenses, assets, property, investments, tax and report journeys.                       All applicable source, GL, reconciliation, rights and export links tested.

  G6 UIX                   111 screens, real-device comparisons, accessibility, empty/loading/error states.                                KK visual approval on actual working UI.

  G7 Integrations and AI   Provider feasibility, licensing, golden documents, issuer accuracy, retries, fallback.                          No unsupported live claims or unsafe auto-posting.

  G8 Operations            Recovery drill, performance, migration, privacy, report and compliance checks.                                  Independent evidence review passed.

  G9 Production            Exact deployment scope, flags, rollback, production parity and separate KK authorisation.                       Explicit approve-and-verify, never automatic publication.
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 8 Test quality and reproducibility

Passing 2,317 local tests is encouraging but insufficient evidence. Record test commit hash, database version, fixture data, repeat count, failures, coverage and whether test touches live services. Eliminate type-check disable in accounting SQL tests. Run isolation tests sequentially if shared database load makes them flaky, and demonstrate deterministic repeated passes. Only a production-like restore gives migration confidence.

Golden document datasets require KK approval and privacy controls. Test amount/date/entity/payment identification separately, false-positive match rate, duplicate replay, multi-page OCR, Excel asset registers, forex, demat corporate actions and prescribed tax output. The 99.9% touch-free ambition cannot be inferred from a small validation set. Fail closed on uncertain or consequential postings.

# 9 UIX design and full-page completion contract

Keep approved Signature Flow visual look: premium deep green, calm warm neutrals, elegant restrained typography and iconography, clean hierarchy, minimum unrelated cards and effortless task navigation. The design reference PDF has ten actual captures, but is not proof of 111 final designs. For each page Claude must produce current screenshot, target reference, difference list and KK review decision. Final Option 02 T symbol is a separate artwork signoff.

Home includes financial picture, one suggested next step, Coming up, calendar icon, notifications and Smart Add. Money includes bank/card/loan/investments/net worth; To-do includes exceptions and approvals; Records includes documents, trips, assets, property, projects and audit. Universal search must reach exact source objects. Every relevant record shows account/ledger, supporting document, owner, transaction and report navigation.

# 10 Production approval package

• Release changelog with exact files, database objects, feature flags and migration ordering.

• Before/after data integrity report by entity, period and currency; independent trial balance and statement checks.

• P1/P2/P3 isolation and restored-copy tests, with rollback timing and failure condition.

• Security threat and permission review; passkey and token-revocation evidence.

• 111-page functional/visual register with actual device screenshots and known limitations.

• Report export cross-format comparison, government schema validation where applicable, integration status and operating costs.

• Backup recovery RPO/RTO measurement, retention, and rollback rehearsals.

• Explicit separate KK approval for read-only production checks, migrations, accounting screen activation, merge and public release.

# 11 Approved P3 accounting decisions

KK explicitly confirmed these fourteen choices on 9 November 2026. They close the accounting-policy decision register for P3 development. They do not authorise applying P1, P2 or P3 to production, activating accounting screens, merging protected branches, accessing live role data or publishing. Claude must update the P3 plan and acceptance tests, and report any new dependency or legal-framework conflict before implementation.

  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Decision                Approved choice                                            Implementation condition
  ----------------------- ---------------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DN-P3-1                 A: Reverse and replace posted edits                        After reviewed legacy conversion; immutable original, reason, actor, link and audit trail.

  DN-P3-2                 A: Exception only for unknown counterpart                  No fabricated balancing line; unresolved item remains in To-do and reconciliation exceptions.

  DN-P3-3                 A: Dated source-backed opening journal                     Never default silently to opening equity; opening totals reconcile with evidence.

  DN-P3-4                 A: Skip closed periods                                     Issue exception report; separately approved prior-period treatment or controlled reopening.

  DN-P3-5                 B: Include personal accounting                             Use same central journal and distinct personal accounting scope; do not create a fictitious registered company or parallel ledger.

  DN-P3-6                 A: Functional-currency lines and original currency         Retain amount/currency, rate, date/source, settlement and FX differences; schema must be extensible for true multicurrency.

  DN-P3-7                 B: Owner and explicitly authorised accountants initially   No broad company-member reads; expand only after P2 scoped-role review and approval.

  DN-P3-8                 B: Company-aware legacy period checks                      Both old and new period checks must evaluate entity, period and posting scope consistently.

  DN-P3-9                 A: Cross-account restore exceptions                        Never remap journal owner by guesswork; preserve original references and safe repair workflow.

  DN-P3-10                A: Undo by reversal                                        Never physically delete posted entries or erase their source evidence.

  DN-P3-11                A: Reconciliation metadata only                            Cannot change financial amount, owner, date, GL or currency without reversal/replacement.

  DN-P3-12                A: Preview and confirm re-sync                             Version and compare affected mappings; automatic triggers require separate validation later.

  DN-P3-13                Mandatory period-close follow-up                           P3 may be developed separately; authoritative journal-backed close cannot release until posting completeness and close/reopen evidence are integrated.

  DN-P3-14                B: Demo guests cannot post journals                        Guests cannot grant, convert or post; test direct API and UI bypass attempts.
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ------------------------------------------ ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Legacy company editor role                 Preserve effective rights; no Bookkeeper or Company Secretary escalation.

# 13 Claude handoff instruction

Treat this V4 as the controlling foundation-recovery sequence appended to the full V3 product scope. Do not remove or weaken any approved requirement. All DN-P3-1 to DN-P3-14 accounting-policy choices in Section 11 are confirmed; update the P3 decision register, migration design and acceptance tests accordingly. Load the V3.1 111-screen contracts, the 1,536 REQ rows, architecture records and the Signature Flow reference as traceability sources. Reconcile their versions before claims of closure. Work in isolated branch and database; start with P1 security and reversible relationship migration design, then P3 financial integrity and first bank month. Every batch must report requirement IDs, code paths, tests, data-parity evidence, screenshots, open decisions and release risk. Wait for explicit KK approval for every production operation.

**REQ-ROL-012 Roles and permissions Auditor Audit room: read-only, frozen snapshot per entity and period, drill TB to ledger to document, sampling, query tracker, change log, UDIN on sign-off. \[In development\]**

**REQ-INV-019 Investments and net worth in the books Every value shows price, date, currency, source and one status (Live, Official close, Delayed, Stale, Valued from evidence, No valuation). \[Partly tested\]**

Requirement text: Every value shows its price, date and time, currency, source and one status: Live quote · Official close · Delayed · Stale · Valued from evidence · No valuation. An old price is never shown as live. Mutual fund NAVs and exchange closing prices are published daily; live prices need a licensed feed (Decision 41). When no current price exists, the last reliable value stays with its date, marked Stale, and an authorised person can update it with evidence.

**REQ-TRS-002 Trusts and 80G Rules map 12A/12AB to section 332, 80G to 354 and Form 10BD to Form 113 from tax year 2026-27; FY 2025-26 donations keep the old forms. \[Not started\]**

Requirement text: \*\*The law changed this year.\*\* From tax year 2026-27, valid 12A or 12AB registrations continue as Registered Non-Profit Organisations under section 332, and 80G approval moves to section 354 (\[BestTaxInfo\](https://www.besttaxinfo.in/?p=2965)). The donation statement Form 10BD is replaced by Form 113, due before 31 May after the tax year (\[TaxHeal\](https://www.taxheal.com/form-113-income-tax-rules-2026-pdf-download-and-key-points.html)). Donations of FY 2025-26 still use the old forms. The AI rules watch keeps this mapping current.

**REQ-TAX-021 Income tax and compliance Tax figures come from posted books under their period\'s law; prepare, review, approve, file, pay, acknowledge and close are separate evidenced steps. \[In development\]**

Requirement text: Every tax figure is built from the posted books and verified tax data, under the law of its own period, and kept separate from the act of filing. Preparing, professional review, your approval, filing, payment, government acknowledgement and closure are distinct steps, each with its own evidence. This extends Tax and compliance, AI rules watch and Governance above.

**REQ-TAX-022 Income tax and compliance Rules, forms and section references follow the period the income belongs to; both Acts stay live and 2025-26 income uses the 1961 Act. \[In development\]**

Requirement text: The Income-tax Act, 1961 continues to govern all tax years beginning before 1 April 2026, and proceedings for those years continue under it. From 1 April 2026 the Income-tax Act, 2025 applies, and its \"tax year\" replaces the old previous year and assessment year (\[Income Tax Department FAQ\](https://www.incometax.gov.in/iec/foportal/help/all-topics/e-filing-services/objective-and-scope-new-act-faq)). Thapal chooses rules, forms and section references by the period the income belongs to, not the date of filing, and keeps both rule sets live: 2025-26 income is computed under the 1961 Act even though its return is filed after 1 April 2026.

**REQ-CAL-047 Calendar and Coming up A private per-workspace ICS subscription link with a revocable secret token and privacy titles works with Apple, Google and Outlook calendars. \[Not started\]**

Requirement text: Phase 3 adds a private subscription link (ICS) per workspace, with a secret token you can revoke, and privacy titles such as \"Payment due\" instead of \"Amex ₹38,920\". Apple, Google and Outlook calendars all accept it. Subscribed calendars refresh on the calendar app\'s own schedule: Google\'s often takes several hours, historically up to about 24, and cannot be forced; Apple Calendar on a Mac lets you choose the interval (\[source\](https://nocal.app/help/ics-and-subscriptions/why-subscribed-calendars-dont-update-instantly)). So time-critical reminders always come from Thapal itself. Two-way Google and Outlook sync through their own connections comes later (see Decisions).

Requirement text: States: Created · Queued · Sent · Accepted by provider · Delivered (only when the provider confirms) · Failed · Retrying · Read (where visible) · Acknowledged · Cancelled. Accepted by provider is never shown as delivered. Failures retry with growing gaps, never send twice, expire when stale, fall back to the next allowed channel and escalate when critical. Admins see a reliability dashboard: generated, sent, confirmed, failed, retrying, acknowledged, critical unresolved, and failures by channel.

Requirement text: Every screen has loading, loaded, empty (with a useful next step), partial or stale, offline, permission denied, recoverable error, hard failure, cancelled, saved-draft and success states, where they apply. Rupees use Indian grouping, the ISO code appears when a symbol is ambiguous, negatives, zero and refunds look distinct, and every value drawn from a source shows its date and source.

**REQ-TAX-060 Income tax and compliance Per entity, year and filing, record rule source, official schema, effective date, applicability, amendments, validation, reviewer, filing, ack and payment. \[In development\]**

Requirement text: The Income-tax Act, 2025 applies from 1 April 2026, and earlier periods keep their own rules (see Tax and compliance, end to end). Neither fact certifies any schedule Thapal produces. For every entity, year and filing type, Thapal records the rule source, official form or schema, effective date, applicability, amendment history, validation result, professional reviewer, submission and acknowledgement, and later the payment proof. A secondary article is never treated as the official format. The same applies to GST, TDS and TCS, trusts and 80G, Companies Act and MCA filings, payroll statutory data, Malaysian reporting (only for entities with that profile, Decision 49) and the DPDP privacy duties as each phase begins.
